verdict.rationale: Highnote documents API issuance of virtual cards (docs-1, docs-27, docs-17) and a test environment that mirrors production (docs-11, docs-26). However, issuance is multi-step: an approved account-holder application and a financial account must exist before a card can be issued (docs-4). Card data is exposed mainly through the iframe Card Viewer SDK, and server-side access requires full PCI compliance (docs-33, docs-43). The phrase "before you talk to anyone" implies going live involves human contact rather than self-serve activation. Missing for 10: single-call card creation, documented programmatic PAN/CVV/expiry retrieval at issuance, and a self-serve sandbox-to-live path without a sales cycle.
